title: Nuclear Engineering Consultant (3975)
description:
Navarro Research and Engineering is recruiting a Nuclear Engineer (3975) that is remote but with some travel to Idaho Falls, ID. This is a consulting position.
Navarro Research & Engineering is an award-winning federal contractor dedicated to partnering with clients to advance clean energy and deliver effective solutions for complex challenges in the nuclear and environmental fields. Joining Navarro means being a part of an exceptional team committed to quality and safety while also looking for innovative strategies to create value for the client’s success. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, Navarro has active programs in place across the nation for DOE/NNSA, NASA, and the Department of Defense.
Position Summary
The Nuclear Engineer will provide analysis and design support for sodium-cooled reactor systems where they are small modular reactors (SMRs), with emphasis on sodium-cooled fast reactor technology. The engineer will apply thermal hydraulics principles, modeling and simulation methods, and reactor systems engineering expertise to evaluate system performance, heat transfer, transients, and safety-related behavior.
This position may be performed remotely and may require travel to Idaho to support conceptual design activities and related technical collaboration.
Responsibilities

• Perform engineering analysis and design for sodium-cooled reactor systems.

• Develop, execute, and evaluate thermal hydraulics models and simulations supporting sodium-cooled fast reactor design and analysis.

• Support reactor systems design activities and evaluate system performance against applicable technical objectives and design criteria.

• Apply computational fluid dynamics tools and/or reactor system analysis codes to assess fluid flow, heat transfer, and system behavior.

• Conduct safety analyses, transient analyses, and heat transfer evaluations for advanced reactor systems.

• Prepare and communicate technical results, assumptions, methods, and conclusions in support of design reviews and conceptual design activities.

• Support nuclear licensing activities, technical design reviews, and advanced reactor development programs, as assigned.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, national laboratories, reactor vendors, and advanced reactor developers, as applicable.

• Travel to Idaho as needed to support conceptual design activities and other project requirements.
Requirements

• Master’s degree or Ph.D. in engineering or a closely related technical discipline.

• Demonstrated experience performing analysis and design for reactor systems.

• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and travel to Idaho as project needs require.
The candidates should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Sodium-cooled fast reactor (SFR) design and analysis

• Thermal hydraulics modeling and simulation

• Reactor systems design and performance evaluation

• Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and/or system codes used in reactor analysis

• Safety analysis, transient analysis, and heat transfer evaluations

• Nuclear licensing, design reviews, or advanced reactor development programs
Education and Experience
A master’s degree or Ph.D. in engineering or a closely related technical discipline is required.
Due to the nature of the government contract requirements and/or clearances requirements, US citizenship is required.

Position Summary
The Document Controller is responsible for managing, organizing, tracking, and maintaining all project documentation throughout the construction project lifecycle. This role ensures that drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, contracts, correspondence, reports, and other project records are properly controlled, distributed, stored, and readily accessible to authorized project stakeholders.
The Document Controller works closely with project managers, engineers, superintendents, subcontractors, consultants, architects, and clients to ensure that project information is accurate, current, and distributed in accordance with established document-control procedures.
Key Responsibilities
Document Management

• Establish and maintain an organized document-control system for construction projects.

• Receive, register, review, distribute, and archive project documents.

• Maintain accurate document registers, logs, and tracking systems.

• Ensure documents are correctly named, numbered, dated, and assigned the appropriate revision/status.

• Maintain electronic and, when required, hard-copy project files.

• Ensure obsolete or superseded documents are identified and removed from active use.
Drawings & Technical Documents

• Control the distribution and revision of construction drawings, specifications, schedules, and technical documents.

• Maintain current drawing registers and revision histories.

• Distribute approved and revised drawings to relevant project teams, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.

• Track the status of shop drawings, material submittals, samples, and other technical submissions.

• Coordinate with engineering and project teams to ensure the latest approved information is available on site.
RFIs, Submittals & Correspondence

• Log and track Requests for Information (RFIs), submittals, transmittals, approvals, and technical queries.

• Monitor document workflows and follow up on outstanding items.

• Prepare and issue transmittals and document distribution records.

• Maintain records of project correspondence, meeting minutes, notices, and formal communications.

• Ensure responses and approvals are properly recorded and linked to the relevant project documentation.
Project Closeout

• Maintain complete and accurate project records throughout construction.

• Assist with the preparation of project handover and closeout documentation.

• Compile and organize as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, certificates, inspection records, and other turnover documents.

• Verify that required closeout documentation has been received and properly filed.

• Support the project team in meeting contractual document-submission requirements.
Quality & Compliance

• Ensure document-control activities comply with company policies, project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable quality standards.

• Support project audits by providing accurate and traceable documentation.

title: EHS Specialist
description:
Baví tě mít pod kontrolou bezpečnost na pracovišti a chceš se starat o prostředí, kde je zdraví zaměstnanců a ochrana majetku na prvním místě? Jako náš EHS Specialist si vezmeš pod křídla rozvoj a zavádění bezpečnostních standardů, které ochrání naše lidi, technologie i celé zázemí firmy.

Nebudeš jen slepě kontrolovat tabulky. Tvým úkolem bude hlídat soulad s místními i mezinárodními předpisy, komunikovat s úřady a hlavně budovat firemní kulturu, kde lidé bezpečnost vnímají jako přirozenou věc. Ve spolupráci s interními týmy i externími partnery budeš neustále vylepšovat naše procesy, snižovat rizika a starat se o to, aby byl náš provoz stabilní a bezpečný za každé situace.

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Bezpečnostní standardy pod kontrolou: Budeš mít hlavní slovo při definování a prosazování EHS a bezpečnostních standardů, směrnic a kontrolních procesů napříč našimi sklady.

- Hodnocení rizik a krizové řízení: Povedeš analýzy rizik a tvorbu krizových plánů. Tvým úkolem bude zajistit, abychom byli stoprocentně připraveni na jakékoli mimořádné nebo bezpečnostní situace.

- Komunikace s úřady a partnery: Budeš klíčovým partnerem pro externí instituce a dodavatele, se kterými budeš řešit soulad s předpisy i efektivní zásahy v praxi.

- Podpora při rozvoji skladů: Zapojíš se do projektů modernizace a rozšiřování našich hal. Pohlídáš, aby se už při návrhu myslelo na moderní bezpečnostní systémy, kamerové okruhy a ochranné prvky.

- Spolupráce napříč firmou: Společně s týmy provozu a HR se budeš podílet na školeních, zajištění první pomoci, vyšetřování příčin případných incidentů a vymýšlení plánů pro jejich trvalé odstranění.

- Správa technických systémů: Budeš v kontaktu s poskytovateli služeb v oblasti fyzické ostrahy, kamerových systémů (CCTV) a alarmů. Dohlédneš na to, aby veškerá technika i služby fungovaly na maximum.

Jak si Tě představujeme?

- Zkušenosti z praxe: Máš prokazatelnou zkušenost z oblasti firemní bezpečnosti, EHS (BOZP/PO) nebo řízení rizik.

- Technický přehled: Vyznáš se v systémech fyzické bezpečnosti - víš, jak fungují kamerové systémy (CCTV), alarmy, EZS nebo přístupové systémy.

- Komunikace s autoritami: Už jsi někdy spolupracoval/a s policií, hasiči nebo jinými orgány veřejné správy.

- Analytická hlava: Umíš vyhodnocovat rizika, hledat skutečné příčiny problémů a přicházet s efektivním řešením.

- Jazyková vybavenost: Vzhledem k mezinárodnímu prostředí potřebuješ plynulou češtinu a angličtinu na úrovni B2 nebo vyšší (pro komunikaci v rámci firmy).

- Výhodou bude: Pokud máš vzdělání v oboru (bezpečnost, požární ochrana), certifikaci jako NEBOSH či odbornou způsobilost, nebo jsi už dříve pracoval v logistice, FMCG či facility, bude to pro tebe obrovské plus.

Co Ti můžeme nabídnout?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Neomezené placené volno - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočinout nebo zařídit rodinné věci, nepočítáme dny.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce každý den.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na oblečení.

- Vzájemné odměňování plné hvězdiček - posílejte si s kolegy body za dobrou práci a nasbíranou částku pak vyměň za nákupy v Alze, Notinu nebo další e-shopech.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!
Sobre a oportunidade
Você vai transformar dados de demanda, ocupação e comportamento de compra em modelos que precificam uma malha com milhares de pares origem-destino e rotas multi trecho - um problema de revenue management cientificamente rico, com inventário perecível de assentos, sazonalidade forte, no-show e tetos regulatórios. É um papel centrado na descoberta: formular hipóteses, validá-las com rigor estatístico e mover receita e margem na escala de milhões de viagens por ano.
Seus Desafios
• Investigação e EDA - conduzir análise exploratória e estatística para descobrir padrões, levantar hipóteses e guiar a modelagem.
• Previsão de demanda - modelar demanda e no-show por par origem-destino com gradient boosting e séries temporais, corrigindo o viés de demanda censurada (unconstrained demand).
• Elasticidade e disposição a pagar - estimar elasticidade-preço e willingness-to-pay por segmento e rota, base para a otimização de preço.
• Revenue management em rede - modelar proteção de assentos e alocação de capacidade (fare buckets) em rotas multi-trecho, equilibrando ocupação e receita.
• Experimentação causal - desenhar testes A/B e inferência causal que validam mudanças de preço e medem uplift real, com critérios estatísticos claros de promoção.
• Explicabilidade e confiança - garantir interpretabilidade (ex.: SHAP) para defender cada preço perante o negócio e o regulador.
• Cold start e calibração - desenhar estratégias para rotas com pouco histórico, partindo de priors de literatura e evoluindo para ML, por tenant.
Você é a ponte entre ciência e produto: colabora com ML engineers no caminho até produção, com data engineers na disponibilidade dos dados, e com as áreas comercial e de operações na definição das metas.
Stack & Ferramentas

•
Linguagem & libs: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels), XGBoost, LightGBM

•
Estatística & ML clássico: EDA, modelos estatísticos, regressão, classificação, clustering

•
Deep learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow

•
Causal & temporal: séries temporais/forecasting, inferência causal (ex.: EconML, DoWhy), bayesiano/hierárquico

•
Revenue management & otimização: elasticidade, fare buckets / seat protection, programação linear

•
Experimentação, MLOps & dados: A/B testing, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray Tune; SHAP, SQL, sobre Athena

O que Buscamos

Essenciais
• Formação quantitativa sólida (Estatística, Economia, Matemática, Engenharia, CC ou afim) e base robusta em probabilidade, inferência e desenho experimental. • Análise exploratória de dados (EDA) e forte capacidade de storytelling e visualização.
• ML clássico (regressão, classificação, clustering) e séries temporais; familiaridade com deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow).
• Python e o ecossistema de Data Science (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels); SQL para dados em larga escala.
• Inferência causal e/ou testes A/B e medição de impacto.
• Comunicação científica clara e conforto com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code).

title: Video Editor
description:

Our client is a dynamic content creation studio specializing in high-quality podcasts, videos, educational content, and digital media. They produce everything from short-form social content to full-length YouTube shows and professional podcast distributions.
They are seeking a skilled and versatile Video Editor who can excel in editing educational videos, event highlight reels, interview content, short-form social clips, and long-form podcast/YouTube episodes. This role is ideal for someone who works fast, communicates clearly, and understands modern content formats across all platforms.
Role Overview
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and efficient under tight deadlines. You must have a strong understanding of current social media trends, pacing for educational content, and long-form storytelling for YouTube and podcasts.
Key Responsibilities
1. Educational Video Editing (Primary Focus)

• Edit short educational videos using raw footage, talking-head content, screen recordings, or multi-camera setups.

• Select the best takes and build clear, engaging narratives.

• Sync high-quality audio with video.

• Add supporting visuals (graphics, lower thirds, on-screen text, B-roll).

• Apply sound effects, licensed music, color correction, and polished finishing touches.

• Add accurate captions for accessibility and sound-off viewing.

2. Short-Form Content Creation (Social Media Clips)

• Review long-form content (YouTube videos, interviews, podcasts) to identify compelling moments.

• Edit short-form clips (15-60 seconds) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, etc.

• Add dynamic captions, text treatments, motion elements, zooms/punch-ins, graphics, and sound design.

• Optimize pacing and hooks for maximum retention and virality.

3. Event Highlight Reels & Interview Content

• Edit high-energy event recaps using professional footage, transitions, text overlays, and music.

• Craft clean, polished interview-based videos with strong narrative flow.

• Incorporate B-roll, branded graphics, and color correction to maintain a consistent visual identity.

4. Long-Form Editing (Podcasts & YouTube)

• Edit full podcast episodes and long-form YouTube videos.

• Assemble multi-camera timelines, add graphics, incorporate B-roll, and create smooth pacing.

• Ensure brand consistency, storytelling clarity, and a clean, polished final output.

5. Audio Editing & Production

• Clean, level, and master audio tracks for podcast release (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, etc.).

• Handle noise reduction, EQ, compression, and clarity enhancement.

• Export final podcast audio in the required platforms’ technical specs.

6. Workflow & Communication

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet quick-turn deadlines.

• Deliver consistent updates, follow organized naming conventions, and maintain efficient file management.

• Communicate proactively about needs, blockers, and delivery timelines.

Requirements

• Proven video editing experience, specifically in:

• Educational videos

• Short-form social content

• Event highlight reels

• Interviews

• Long-form podcast or YouTube content

• Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following editing software's:

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Strong understanding of:

• Social trends and viral content structure

• Video codecs, formats, and aspect ratios

• Color correction and basic motion graphics

• Audio editing and mixing

• Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.

• Creative instincts and an eye for storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement.

title: Nurse Practitioner
description:
G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.
Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.
We know the current healthcare system isn’t meeting the needs of the modern Australian, and we reckon there’s a better, more holistic way. Our programs across hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management are easy, accessible and completely discreet.
More than a job
There’s nothing better than knowing the work you’re doing matters and makes a genuine difference. We’re pretty lucky that, at Mosh & Moshy, this is the norm rather than the exception.
We’re looking for two endorsed Nurse Practitioners to join our multidisciplinary clinical team and provide high-quality, evidence-based care at an advanced nursing level. Working remotely, you’ll help improve patients’ access to healthcare and support them throughout their treatment journey.
Reporting to our Clinical Operations Manager, you’ll combine strong clinical judgement with clear, compassionate communication to deliver a seamless telehealth experience.
What you’ll do
As a Nurse Practitioner, you’ll:

• Consult with new and existing patients via telephone and video, providing education, clinical advice and support

• Manage patients’ ongoing treatment plans, including assessing their response to treatment

• Prescribe appropriate medications and adjust treatment where clinically indicated and within your scope of practice

• Triage presenting symptoms and escalate or refer patients to the appropriate medical practitioner or pharmacist

• Collaborate with medical practitioners, pharmacists, allied health professionals and our wider Clinical Operations team

• Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation and uphold our clinical governance and code-of-conduct requirements

• Share insights and feedback to continually improve our clinical systems, workflows and overall patient experience

Experience you’ll bring
To succeed in this role, you’ll have:

• A completed Master of Nursing and current endorsement as a Nurse Practitioner with AHPRA

• A current PBS prescriber number, or the ability to obtain one

• Recent experience working as a Nurse Practitioner within primary healthcare

• Strong clinical judgement and a commitment to safe, evidence-based, patient-centred care

• Confident, clear and empathetic communication skills, particularly in telephone and video consultations

• The ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical environment

• Confidence navigating digital clinical platforms, documentation systems and telehealth tools

• A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve patient care, systems and processes

What’s on offer
We hire people who share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of healthcare. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

• A fully remote role with the flexibility to work from home, within Australia

• Meaningful work that makes a real, positive difference in patients’ lives

• Plenty of opportunity to learn and grow as the company evolves

• Access to up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Two additional paid company closure days each year

• Two days of purpose leave for mental health or learning and development

• Access to on-demand learning through Go1

• EAP support and online wellbeing programs

• ClassPass credit discounts

• Discounts across a range of Mosh & Moshy products and services

• A creative, friendly and collaborative team

Better, together
Everyone is different, and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe our differences generate better ideas, bring valuable perspectives and help us represent the people we care for.
If you’re excited by the opportunity but don’t tick every single box, we’d still love to hear from you.
